tasks.title: P6.3 _not_eligible quarantine + dedup — partition findings into eligible vs quarantined (pure, injected existing-corpus)
acceptance_criteria: New file ngv2/submission_quarantine.py is created with the VALIDATED implementation shipped verbatim from the brief (no edits, no reformatting).
The already-committed RED oracle tests/ngv2/test_submission_quarantine_wired.py turns green and is NOT modified.
Module is pure and stdlib-only: no file/network I/O, no subprocess, no LLM, no wall-clock, no randomness.
partition_findings does not mutate caller finding dicts in place (returns annotated copies); quarantine reasons follow the documented precedence.
Module exposes partition_findings, dedup_key, and the four REASON_* constants via __all__.

spec.objective: Create the new pure, stdlib-only module ngv2/submission_quarantine.py that ports the legacy _not_eligible/ quarantine: partition an iterable of finding dicts into an 'eligible' (submittable) bucket and a 'quarantined' bucket, routing ineligible (explicit eligible=False), unconfirmed (present verdict != 'confirmed'), and duplicate (already-submitted or within-batch collision) findings to quarantine annotated with quarantine_reason. The implementation is VALIDATED and must be shipped VERBATIM as the whole file.
functional_requirements: Provide dedup_key(finding) -> (repo, cwe) returning a canonical, normalized key using finding['repo'] or finding['repo_url'] for repo and finding['cwe'] or finding['category'] for cwe, each lowercased and whitespace-stripped via the _norm helper.
Provide partition_findings(findings, existing_keys=None) -> {'eligible': [...], 'quarantined': [...]} returning a fresh dict with exactly those two list keys.
Quarantine findings with an explicit eligible=False under quarantine_reason == REASON_INELIGIBLE; default to eligible when the 'eligible' key is absent.
Quarantine findings that carry a 'verdict' key whose normalized value is not 'confirmed' under REASON_NOT_CONFIRMED; findings without a 'verdict' key are not gated on confirmation.
Quarantine findings whose dedup_key matches a normalized entry of the injected existing_keys corpus under REASON_DUPLICATE_EXISTING.
For within-batch duplicates of the same dedup_key, pass the FIRST occurrence and quarantine subsequent ones under REASON_DUPLICATE_BATCH.
Apply the reason precedence order ineligible > not_confirmed > duplicate_existing > duplicate_batch (first matching condition wins).
Never mutate the caller's finding dicts in place: eligible and quarantined buckets contain shallow copies (dict(finding)), and quarantined copies carry the added quarantine_reason key.

Define module constants REASON_INELIGIBLE='ineligible', REASON_NOT_CONFIRMED='not_confirmed', REASON_DUPLICATE_EXISTING='duplicate_existing', REASON_DUPLICATE_BATCH='duplicate_batch' and export dedup_key, partition_findings and the four constants via __all__.
Treat None inputs gracefully: a None findings iterable yields empty buckets, and a None existing_keys is treated as an empty corpus.
spec.interfaces: exposes partition_findings(findings, existing_keys=None) -> {'eligible': [...], 'quarantined': [...]} routing ineligible/unconfirmed/duplicate findings to quarantine (each annotated with quarantine_reason) and passing only genuinely submittable findings; plus dedup_key(finding) -> (repo, cwe) and the reason constants REASON_INELIGIBLE / REASON_NOT_CONFIRMED / REASON_DUPLICATE_EXISTING / REASON_DUPLICATE_BATCH.
edge_cases: None existing_keys behaves identically to an empty corpus.
existing_keys entries are normalized (lowercased/stripped) before comparison so casing/whitespace differences still match.
A finding missing 'repo'/'repo_url' or 'cwe'/'category' still produces a stable ('','') or partial key without raising.
eligible=False takes precedence even when the finding is also a duplicate or unconfirmed.
verdict present but empty/whitespace/non-'confirmed' is quarantined as not_confirmed; verdict absent is not gated.
Three+ same-key findings in one batch: exactly one passes, the rest are duplicate_batch (assuming none also hit a higher-precedence reason).
A finding that is both already-submitted (duplicate_existing) and a within-batch repeat is labelled duplicate_existing (higher precedence).
non_goals: No file or network I/O — the already-submitted corpus is injected as existing_keys, not read from huntr_existing_submissions.json here.
No subprocess, LLM, wall-clock, or randomness.
Do NOT render the submission document (P6.1) or pin permalinks (P6.2).
Do not modify the committed RED oracle tests/ngv2/test_submission_quarantine_wired.py.
spec.implementation_notes:
Ship the VALIDATED implementation from the brief VERBATIM as the entire contents of ngv2/submission_quarantine.py — including the module docstring, `from __future__ import annotations`, typing imports, the REASON_* constants, __all__, _norm, dedup_key, _is_eligible, _is_confirmed, and partition_findings exactly as given. Do not rename, reorder, or reformat. The oracle has already been proven green against this exact text, so the only correct action is a faithful verbatim drop-in. Ensure the ngv2 package directory exists/import path resolves.

If the spec mentions pydantic-style validation, re-express it with stdlib dataclasses + manual checks.

Do NOT call datetime.now / datetime.utcnow, time.time / time.monotonic, unseeded random, uuid, os.urandom, or secrets to obtain a timestamp / id / randomness. Instead accept any timestamp, seed, or clock as an EXPLICIT parameter with a deterministic default (the oracle injects it, e.g. via now_fn / make_scripted_clock), so the same inputs always produce the same output.


# COMMITTED ORACLE CONTRACT (authoritative; you cannot read these files at synthesis time so they are reproduced verbatim -- your code MUST make them pass):

## tests/ngv2/test_submission_quarantine_wired.py
```python
"""Wired RED oracle for ngv2/submission_quarantine.py (P6.3)."""
from ngv2.submission_quarantine import (
    partition_findings,
    dedup_key,
    REASON_INELIGIBLE,
    REASON_NOT_CONFIRMED,
    REASON_DUPLICATE_EXISTING,
    REASON_DUPLICATE_BATCH,
)


def test_dedup_key_normalizes():
    assert dedup_key({'repo': 'Org/Repo', 'cwe': 'CWE-22'}) == ('org/repo', 'cwe-22')


def test_eligible_finding_passes():
    findings = [{'id': 'A-1', 'repo': 'org/repo', 'cwe': 'CWE-22',
                 'verdict': 'confirmed'}]
    out = partition_findings(findings, existing_keys=[])
    assert len(out['eligible']) == 1
    assert out['quarantined'] == []


def test_ineligible_routes_to_quarantine():
    findings = [{'id': 'A-1', 'repo': 'org/repo', 'cwe': 'CWE-22',
                 'eligible': False}]
    out = partition_findings(findings, existing_keys=[])
    assert out['eligible'] == []
    assert len(out['quarantined']) == 1
    assert out['quarantined'][0]['quarantine_reason'] == REASON_INELIGIBLE


def test_unconfirmed_routes_to_quarantine():
    findings = [{'id': 'A-1', 'repo': 'org/repo', 'cwe': 'CWE-22',
                 'verdict': 'inconclusive'}]
    out = partition_findings(findings, existing_keys=[])
    assert out['eligible'] == []
    assert out['quarantined'][0]['quarantine_reason'] == REASON_NOT_CONFIRMED


def test_existing_duplicate_quarantined():
    findings = [{'id': 'A-1', 'repo': 'org/repo', 'cwe': 'CWE-22'}]
    out = partition_findings(findings, existing_keys=[('org/repo', 'CWE-22')])
    assert out['eligible'] == []
    assert out['quarantined'][0]['quarantine_reason'] == REASON_DUPLICATE_EXISTING


def test_batch_duplicate_first_passes_rest_quarantined():
    findings = [
        {'id': 'A-1', 'repo': 'org/repo', 'cwe': 'CWE-22'},
        {'id': 'A-2', 'repo': 'org/repo', 'cwe': 'CWE-22'},
        {'id': 'A-3', 'repo': 'ORG/REPO', 'cwe': 'cwe-22'},
    ]
    out = partition_findings(findings, existing_keys=[])
    assert len(out['eligible']) == 1
    assert out['eligible'][0]['id'] == 'A-1'
    assert len(out['quarantined']) == 2
    assert all(q['quarantine_reason'] == REASON_DUPLICATE_BATCH
               for q in out['quarantined'])


def test_mixed_batch_routes_correctly():
    findings = [
        {'id': 'GOOD', 'repo': 'a/b', 'cwe': 'CWE-78', 'verdict': 'confirmed'},
        {'id': 'INELIG', 'repo': 'c/d', 'cwe': 'CWE-22', 'eligible': False},
        {'id': 'DUPX', 'repo': 'e/f', 'cwe': 'CWE-89'},
    ]
    out = partition_findings(findings, existing_keys=[('e/f', 'CWE-89')])
    assert {f['id'] for f in out['eligible']} == {'GOOD'}
    assert {f['id'] for f in out['quarantined']} == {'INELIG', 'DUPX'}


def test_does_not_mutate_inputs():
    findings = [{'id': 'A-1', 'repo': 'org/repo', 'cwe': 'CWE-22',
                 'eligible': False}]
    partition_findings(findings, existing_keys=[])
    assert 'quarantine_reason' not in findings[0]

```

test_spec.test_data_requirements: Synthetic in-memory finding dicts only (no files): a baseline submittable finding (repo/cwe present, verdict='confirmed' or absent, eligible absent/True); an eligible=False finding; a finding with verdict='rejected'/'' ; duplicate pairs/triples sharing a (repo,cwe) key; a finding whose key appears in an injected existing_keys list (with deliberate casing/whitespace variants to exercise normalization); and None/empty inputs. The committed RED oracle tests/ngv2/test_submission_quarantine_wired.py is the authoritative acceptance check and must remain unmodified.
